title: DAF-SELEX Trial 1 - Buffer Preparation
body:
### 1. DAF-Seq Buffer (Buffer A)		
		
| Reagent | Volume | Final Conc. |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| NF H2O | Upto 999 uL  |  |
| 1 M Tris-Cl, pH 8.0 | 15 uL | 15 mM Tris-Cl, pH 8.0 |
| 100 mM NaCl | 150 uL | 15 mM NaCl |
| 100 mM KCl | 600 uL | 60 mM KCl |
| 0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0 | 2 uL | 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0 |
| 0.5 M EGTA, pH 8.0 | 1 uL | 0.5 mM EGTA, pH 8.0 |

Filter and store this buffer at -20 deg, without addition of Spermidine.

Add 1 uL of 0.5 M spermidine to 999 uL of buffer A stock right before using. Store spermidine at -20 C for up to 6 months.

### 2. Adapter & Hairpin annealing buffers

10X Annealing Buffer (10 mL)

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8.0 | 1 mL |
| NaCl | 2.92 g |
